statement: The review template is worker-agnostic: a team of a Codex CLI Worker and an Antigravity CLI Worker is non-inferior to a team of a ChatGPT website Worker and a Gemini website Worker on correctly identified actionable defects per cost, with blocking-defect recall at or above the floor.

mechanism.text: The template's guarantees (sealed ballots, quote checks, the blocking-finding rule) do not depend on the Worker source its members run on.

intervention.text: Both website members replaced by agent CLI members of two other families.

context.text: Exact-subject reviews of pinned commits of system's own public repository, read offline.
